_about: Approved billing and Journey copy (Arun, 25 Nov 2026). Shared keys are identical on both apps; store keys differ only in the store name. No billing string shows a date: Google Play and the App Store show them. Checked by test/unit/billing_copy_test.dart and EkadashiCoreTests/BillingCopyTests.swift.

premium_feature_vrat.both: Unlimited Vrat entries (the first three are free)

ios_journey_premium_desc.both: Unlimited Vrat entries and complete badge collection
